units.name: Berserker
units.description:
Fast and light infantry that have good damage and are effective against light units.
+ High movement
+ When health is below 25% they will heal and get increased damage
- Low Armor
- Countered by Archers

units.name: Bondi
units.description:
Infantry best used against mounted units with increased health and armor. While they are near other Bondi they form a shield wall giving them bonus health.
+ Anti-cavalry specialist
+ Additional damage against Elephants
- More expensive
- Weak against heavy infantry
- Countered by Archers

units.name: Scout
units.description:
Lightly armed cavalry effective at exploring the world, hunting wildlife, and herding Sheep.
+ Able to see into Stealth Forests
+ Health regeneration
+ High movement speed
- Very weak in combat

units.name: Fishing Knarr

units.name: Villager
units.description:

buildings.name: Baugr Fort
buildings.description:
Acts as a Barracks with all units and technologies. All Barracks work +25% faster and reduces Barracks technology costs by 15%.

Immediately upgrades Bondi and Berserkers to Hardened.

buildings.name: Town Center
buildings.description:
All Resources can be dropped off here. Produces Villagers, Scouts, and increases your maximum Population. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned.

Capital Town Centers can detect units stealth or disguises. Pillars near the Viking Capital are slowly revealed to show Saga progress.

buildings.name: Town Center
buildings.description:
All Resources can be dropped off here. Produces Villagers, Scouts, and increases your maximum Population. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned.

Non-Capital Town Centers can't detect stealth or disguises.

buildings.name: Konungr Hall
buildings.description:
Hosts a feast every 60 seconds which provides 10 Food +5 Food for each Longhouse and has a one-time Shield Maiden rally.

Can recruit Shield Maidens up to 1 +1 for each Longhouse constructed.

buildings.name: Longhouse
buildings.description: Increases your Villager capacity by +10 and your maximum Population by +25. Produces Bondi spearmen but 25% slower. Can be upgraded with one of four possible attachments to increase the versatility of the Longhouse.

buildings.name: Mill
buildings.description: Villagers can drop off Food at this building. Houses technologies to improve Food gathering.

buildings.name: Palisade
buildings.description:
Light defensive wall for quickly fortifying an area.

Initially costs 21 Wood, with each additional section costing 7 Wood.

buildings.name: Palisade
buildings.description: Light defensive wall for quickly fortifying an area.

buildings.name: Saga Pillars
buildings.description: Carve the story of your Sagas in each of the Pillars of this site. Inspiring the people and immortalizing your legend.

buildings.name: Dock
buildings.description:
Produces naval units.

Automatically repairs nearby damaged naval units.

Capable of holding up to three Fishing Ships.

buildings.name: Danevirke Gate
buildings.description: Light defensive gate. Must be built on a Danevirke Wall segment.

buildings.name: Palisade Gate
buildings.description: Light defensive gate. Must be built on a Palisade Wall segment.

buildings.name: Outpost
buildings.description: Offers extensive line of sight and detects units stealth or disguises. Can be upgraded with weaponry and fortifications. Attacks while garrisoned.

buildings.name: Sacred Grove
buildings.description:
The Sacred Grove increases the armor of nearby units by +1 and Berserkers are automatically recruited at the Sacred Grove.

The Sacred Grove health regenerates at 5/s if no enemies are nearby for at least 30 seconds.

Limited to 3 Sacred Groves.

buildings.name: Sacred Grove
buildings.description:
The Sacred Grove increases the armor of nearby units by +1 and Berserkers are automatically recruited at the Sacred Grove. Can be placed on Sacred Sites and will capture the Sacred Site.

The Sacred Grove health regenerates at 5/s if no enemies are nearby for at least 30 seconds.

Limited to 3 Sacred Groves.

buildings.description: Produces ranged infantry units.

buildings.name: Valdemar Castle
buildings.description: Acts as a Keep. Grants the Danevirke technology which replaces Palisades with stronger walls that have +5 fire armor. Jylland Knights grant 20 more Gold when they are killed.

buildings.name: Stable
buildings.description: Produces cavalry military units.

buildings.name: Market
buildings.description: Allows the buying and selling of resources and produces the Trader.

buildings.name: Monastery
buildings.description: Produces religious units and houses religious technologies. Starting in the Castle Age (III), religious units can pick up Relics and place them in this building to generate Gold.

buildings.name: Gullinn Temple
buildings.description: Acts as a Sacred Grove. Allows Völur to establish Sacred Groves on Sacred Sites and unlock the Dreki Saga which increases Sacred Grove Berserker production by 15%.

buildings.name: Siege Workshop
buildings.description: Produces siege engines and powerful gunpowder units.

buildings.name: Kongens Dør Cathedral
buildings.description: Acts as a Monastery. Increases population and maximum population by +10. Has a slowly expanding area that gathers a tithe of 10 Gold for each Longhouse every 30 seconds. Has a unique technology that further increases maximum population.

buildings.description: Acts as a Keep that fires volleys of arrows. Increases population and maximum population by +10. Reduces the cost of all unit tier technologies by 50%. Recruits 10 Skåne Crossbowmen upon construction completion.
